propositions: pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 with anthropic 0.120.2 causes ImportError: pydantic_ai.models.anthropic cannot find UserLocation (renamed to BetaUserLocationParam in anthropic 0.120.2)

uv's universal extras resolution pins pydantic-ai-slim below 1.107 due to boto3 conflict: inspect-ai → aiobotocore 2.25.1 requires boto3<1.40.62 while pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]>=1.107 requires boto3>=1.42.63
pip-based installs (make install) are unaffected because they resolve extras separately, yielding pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2
declaring [tool.uv] conflicts between eval+bedrock and eval+dev extras allows uv to resolve pydantic-ai-slim>=1.107 with compatible anthropic
a fresh uv lock after raising pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107,<2 and adding the conflicts block resolves to pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2
